description.fun: Froakie looks carefree, but the dopey grin is an act: it watches everything, then drops the pose and overwhelms foes with blinding speed. The foamy 'Frubbles' around its neck and back cushion blows, and its light, strong body lets it leap high enough to pelt foes' heads with springy bubbles. Its foam scarf echoes the cloth bundles carried by thieves in Japanese folklore, a hint of the ninja it grows into.
description.guide: Froakie is a Water-type frog Pokémon and one of the three first partner Pokémon of Kalos in Pokémon X and Y. It wears a mane of cushioning bubbles called Frubbles and hides a watchful, nimble nature behind a happy-go-lucky look. It evolves into Frogadier and then the ninja frog Greninja.
description.tagline: A bubble-scarfed frog whose goofy face hides blinding speed

description.fun: Frogadier is a ninja in training: sticky fingertips and toes let it scale a 600-metre tower in a minute, and it bounds across ceilings and through trees to bewilder opponents. It plans its battles around the terrain and never misses with the bubble-coated pebbles it throws from 30 metres away. The spikes over its eyes come from horned frogs, and its name from 'brigadier' or 'grenadier'.
description.guide: Frogadier is a Water-type Pokémon, the middle stage of Froakie's line. It is extremely agile, climbing sheer walls with its sticky fingers and toes, and throws bubble-coated pebbles with great accuracy. Its hooded look and foam scarf are based on a ninja.
description.tagline: A wall-climbing frog ninja that never misses its throw

description.fun: Greninja slips in and out of sight like a ninja, slicing foes with throwing stars of compressed water sharp enough to cut metal, and wears its own long tongue as a scarf that senses movement in the air. It was picked for Super Smash Bros. before Pokémon X and Y were even out, and fans voted it Pokémon of the Year in 2020. A rare bond with its Trainer can even give it Ash Ketchum's look.
description.guide: Greninja is a Water- and Dark-type Pokémon, the final form of Froakie, based on a frog and a ninja. It throws shuriken made of compressed water and wraps its long tongue around its neck like a scarf. It has a special Ash-Greninja form and a Mega Evolution introduced in Pokémon Legends: Z-A, and won the 2020 Pokémon of the Year vote.
description.tagline: The tongue-scarfed ninja frog that fans crowned Pokémon of the Year

description.fun: Through the Bond Phenomenon, a Greninja with Battle Bond that knocks out a foe takes on the look of Ash Ketchum from the animated series, with a red crest, black 'hair' tufts and a giant Water Shuriken on its back. It only exists in Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon, so it has never had a Pokédex entry.

Mega Greninja, from Pokémon Legends: Z-A, dresses all in ninja black and clings upside down beneath a giant spinning six-pointed Water Shuriken, with real shuriken where its thigh stars were. It gives up stealth for showing off, baiting foes to attack, then tying them up with its tongue.
